title: Degradation Simulation and Operator Training Roadmap 2027
author: Maya Chen
content:
Introduction:
This roadmap defines a cross-functional program to build a repeatable degradation-simulation lab, link it to operator training, and integrate SLI-aware verification gates into our CI/CD pipeline. The program aims to reduce on-call time-to-mitigate for cost- and latency-driven degradations while improving operator preparedness for mixed failure modes.

Context:
- Platform trends: increasing multi-model routing, tenant volume variance, and dynamic autoscaling lead to complex failure interactions.
- Problem statement: recurring SLO burn is driven by correlated failures (e.g., cache prefetch miss + autoscaler oscillation + regional networking blips). Existing exercises lack fidelity and playbooks are inconsistently executed.

Goals:
1) Build a reproducible degradation lab capable of running mixed failure scenarios against production-like topologies.
2) Deliver an operator certification program tied to canonical scenarios and practical exercises.
3) Add automated SLI verification gates into the canary pipeline to catch regressions before full rollout.
4) Reduce mean time to mitigate (MTTM) for degradation incidents by 40% within six months of launch.

Scope (included):
- Operator playbook validation, synthetic workload generation, KV prefix-cache failure injection, autoscaler oscillation scenarios, tenant-cost-surge simulations, regional fallback stress tests, training curriculum and assessments.

Scope (excluded):
- Hardware thermal stress testing, vendor control-plane outages unless reproduced via lab network partitioning, and any use of production customer data or credentials.

Timeline (high-level):
- Q4 2026: Prototype harness + three seed scenarios (cache-miss cascade, autoscaler oscillation, model-variant fallback). Create initial exercise materials.
- Q1 2027: Expand to 12 scenarios. Run first training cohort. Integrate basic SLI checks into canary flow.
- Q2 2027: Automate scenario replay for pre-deploy validation. Launch operator certification.
- Q3 2027: Require verification gates for batching/eviction changes. Measure MTTM and iterate.

Success metrics:
- MTTM reduction: 40% improvement target within 6 months.
- Canary regression rate: <= 0.5% of canary commits cause SLI regressions that reach production alerts.
- Training coverage: 100% of on-call rotation completes hands-on simulation within 3 months of role entry.
- Scenario coverage: 80% of historically high-severity scenarios represented by Q2 2027.

Sample scenario catalog (summary table):
| id | name | primary failure | operator action | verification assertion |
| S-01 | Warm-prefix-cache-collapse | KV prefix cache eviction spike | Rebalance prefixes, enable soft-prefetch | p99 latency improves to within 15% of baseline after mitigation |
| S-05 | Autoscaler-oscillation-loop | Overreactive scaling + tenant burst | Pin autoscaler policy, manual cap override | Eviction rate stabilizes within 3 minutes |
| S-09 | Fallback-model-mismatch | Incorrect variant routing | Rollback model-swap, toggle canary | Token error-rate returns to baseline |

Operator curriculum (modules):
- Module 0: Platform SLI primer (self-study)
- Module 1: Lab orientation & safe sandboxing (instructor-led)
- Module 2: Scenario tabletop walkthroughs
- Module 3: Timed runbook execution (live exercises)
- Module 4: Triage & post-exercise writing (postmortem practice)
- Assessment: practical live scenario + written knowledge check

Training deliverables:
- Single-page scenario pocket-cards
- Lab harness container and topology manifest
- Certification badge (valid 12 months) and remediation paths
- Public scenario registry with run artifacts and teachbacks

Automation and verification strategy:
1) Hook lab harness to CI: candidate changes trigger a non-destructive set of scenarios against a blue environment.
2) Gate definitions: automated SLI assertions evaluating tail latency (p99), token-error-rate, and eviction-rate determine pass/fail.
3) On failure: a templated incident artifact is created with traces, reproducible manifest, and linked ticket for triage.

Dashboards and alerts (requirements):
- Dashboards: "Degradation Lab Runs" (run status, pass/fail, run-time, impacted SLIs); "Operator Exercise Progress" (cohort metrics); "Canary SLI Gate" (commits and gate status).
- Alerts:
  - Canary SLI gate failure -> notify engineering-canary@redwood (P2), create ticket
  - Lab harness infrastructure failure -> infra-ops on-call (P3)

Runbook excerpt: S-05 Autoscaler-oscillation-loop (operator steps):
1. Observe autoscaler dashboard for eviction and scale activity. Capture a 5-minute logs/trace window.
2. Apply a temporary manual autoscaler cap: redwood-ops autoscaler set-cap --pool pool-23 --cap 12
3. Enable tenant soft-eviction throttle to shed non-critical traffic.
4. Monitor eviction-rate and p99 latency for 10 minutes. If metrics do not improve, escalate to runtime-core team.
5. After stabilization, revert manual cap and annotate the incident with timestamps and hypotheses.

Operator safety and sandbox rules:
- Use synthetic prompts and consented traces; do not use production keys or customer payloads.
- Network partitions must be reversible and bounded by orchestration TTLs.
- Any scenario that could incur billable workloads requires finance approval and must run under lab quotas.

Ownership and roles:
- Program lead: Maya Chen (Platform Reliability)
- Lab infrastructure: Runtime Platform team
- Curriculum & training: Operator Enablement (Eng-Platform)
- CI/verification gates: Release Engineering
- Executive sponsor: VP Platform

Risks and mitigations:
- False confidence from synthetic workloads: mitigate by pairing scenarios with anonymized production traces where possible.
- Cognitive overload for operators: prioritize top-12 scenarios by impact, rotate deep dives quarterly.
- Lab cost: use scaled-down topologies and simulated token accounting; implement team chargeback for heavy runs.

Rollout checklist (pre-launch):
- Harness deployed to staging and smoke-tested.
- Dashboards and alerting templates created and reviewed.
- First cohort scheduled; materials and reviewers assigned.
- Canary gate validated in non-critical feature pipeline.
- Communication plan drafted and distribution list finalized.

Appendix: topology manifest (YAML snippet):
name: degradation-lab-topology-v1
region: us-west-2
clusters:
  - name: blue-1
    node-pools:
      - type: inference-cpu
        count: "4"
      - type: inference-gpu
        count: "2"
workload-samples:
  - id: synth-chat-1
    rps: "30"
    seq_length: "512"

SLI definitions:
- p99 token latency: time to first token 99th percentile measured at edge.
- token-error-rate: percentage of requests returning model errors.
- eviction-rate: tokens evicted per second from prefix cache.
